title: Toolchain team config
description: Schema for toolchain.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the toolchain plugin's settings. Keys are read by the result-gate Stop hook and listed in plugins/toolchain/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

result_gate_enabled.description: Whether the turn-end Stop hook checks the tree's recorded check or lint result. Only true takes effect: a repository can turn the hook on for contributors who have not set their own value, but a false here is ignored, and only a user's or managed pluginConfigs value turns it off.
